method: Post-ambivalence audit Aug 2026: live gameData + effect pipeline. T1 dens≥1.20 cluster already closed (all T1 dens=1.00). P0 mostly shipped.

summary.verdict: P0 ship blockers largely live. T1 density pack already fixed (I5/BP5 dens=1.00). Remaining: Bestechung/Maulwurf toxic AV (gated), P1 meta warpers, Monte Carlo validate. Ambivalence metric + 3 interactive cards shipped.

assertions.name: Bestechungsskandal 2.0
assertions.claim: BP5 + W6≥influence with no oligarch stacking shipped. Still a permanent steal — high Emitter AV; fairer but watch-list.
assertions.fix: Monitor; optional once-per-match if steal rate stays oppressive in sims.

assertions.name: Maulwurf
assertions.claim: BP4 + flat W6≥4 + return-to-hand on fail shipped. Permanent steal on success still high AV.
assertions.fix: Acceptable for now; Monte Carlo check steal frequency.

assertions.name: Ai Weiwei
assertions.claim: Live effect is opp-initiative AP steal 1×/turn (not infinite draw+AP). Assertions were stale.

assertions.name: Parlament geschlossen
assertions.claim: Already turn-lock until victim start-of-turn (not round-wide).

assertions.name: Jeff Bezos
assertions.claim: Already removes opponent oligarchs only. High Emitter AV via archetype wipe.

assertions.name: Tunnelvision
assertions.claim: Deterministic Freigabe: +1 AP or +1 corruption on entry (no W6). Opp-only tax.

assertions.name: Pass-Audit (no RNG after double-pass)
assertions.claim: CRITICAL: After both players pass, no random event may decide board/score. Deterministic audit stages 0–6 only.

assertions.name: Führungsstil-Passive
assertions.claim: Style passives ≤1 point scoring swing per round; champion actives 1×/match for 1 AP. Character depth, not win condition.
assertions.fix: BP-first tuning on numbers only; never homogenize verbs across styles.

assertions.name: Skandalspirale
assertions.claim: Deterministic −2 influence on strongest gov of lower-influence side (no W6).

assertions.name: Oppositionsblockade
assertions.claim: Full initiative lock until EOT. Shuts traps+sofort package for a turn at mid cost.
assertions.fix: Lock Sofort only, or allow 1 initiative through.

assertions.name: Partei-Offensive
assertions.claim: Hard-deactivates strongest enemy gov, no dice. Direct score deletion.
assertions.fix: −2/−3 instead of full deactivate, or dice check.

assertions.name: Cyber-Attacke
assertions.claim: DESTROYS platform (permanent), not deactivate. Punishes Meta/Cook engines lethally.
assertions.fix: Deactivate instead of destroy, or return to hand.

assertions.name: Digitaler Wahlkampf
assertions.claim: Draw capped at 2 in live queue resolver.
assertions.fix: Keep; verify legacy useGameEffects path stays unused.

assertions.name: Whataboutism
assertions.claim: Reactivates deactivated card for 2 BP — undoes expensive removal at discount (even with −1).
assertions.fix: Cost 3, or only publics, or −2 influence.

assertions.name: T1 density cluster
assertions.claim: Former ~1.25 dens pack already closed: all T1 influence=5 cards are BP5 (dens=1.00). Prestige T2 dens≈0.59 gap remains intentional win-condition inefficiency.
assertions.fix: Keep; no further T1 BP raise required.

assertions.name: Koalitionszwang
assertions.claim: On-play capped +2; T2 aura suppressed same turn after on-play (anti double-dip).

assertions.name: Tim Cook
assertions.claim: Unconditional +2 AP on play. Immediate double-action without board setup.
assertions.fix: +1 AP, or +2 only if Platform already present.

assertions.name: Elon Musk
assertions.claim: Draw + once/turn AP on initiative. Powerful but deckCost 8 is a real brake.
assertions.fix: Monitor; optional once-per-round instead of once-per-turn.

assertions.name: Cancel Culture
assertions.claim: Deactivates any public on play — broad hate trap at low cost.

assertions.name: Interne Fraktionskämpfe
assertions.claim: Cancels big (3+ BP) initiatives cheaply — good hate, can feel binary.
assertions.fix: Acceptable if big inits stay rare; else BP3.

assertions.name: Warren Buffett
assertions.claim: +1 AP on play + aura +1 strongest gov if no gov played — passive score creep.
assertions.fix: Aura only OR on-play AP, not both.

assertions.name: Napoleon Komplex
assertions.claim: T1 +1 aura; dens cluster no longer amplifies it (T1 dens flat at 1.00). Slot-limited.

assertions.name: Greta Thunberg
assertions.claim: First gov each turn +1 AP — reliable tempo in gov decks.
assertions.fix: Fine; watch with Ai Weiwei stacks.

assertions.name: Alternative Fakten
assertions.claim: −1 to enemy intervention magnitude. Solid hate, not round-winning alone.

assertions.name: Scandal Spiral
assertions.claim: Cancels 2nd public only — situational, rewards holding the trap.

assertions.name: Spin Doctor
assertions.claim: Strongest gov +2. Clear, fair tempo/score bump.

assertions.name: Satire-Show
assertions.claim: Conditional −2 if you trail — comeback tool with a check.

assertions.name: Symbolpolitik
assertions.claim: Draw 1, nothing else. Intentional floor filler.

assertions.name: Standard T2 prestige (Putin/Xi/etc)
assertions.claim: High influence, terrible dens (~0.59). Fair win-condition cards if T1 dens is fixed.

assertions.name: Milchglas Transparenz
assertions.claim: +1 if no NGO/movement — niche anti-activist tech.

assertions.name: Lobby Leak
assertions.claim: Force discard on NGO play — fair tax.

density.note: Live Aug 2026: all T1 dens=1.00 (I==BP). Former dens≥1.20 pack retired. T2 prestige remains ~0.59 dens as intentional bombs.
